name: Freudenberg (North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically blue and yellow, charged at the top with the city arms of Freudenberg (a yellow castle on blue).
history: The arms were most recently granted on 24 June 1970; the city bears a city flag (banner) striped lengthwise in the colours of the arms.

features.role: Freudenberg arms — yellow castle on blue
